name: Highlord Demitrian
summary: Among the strange crystals of northwestern Silithus, Highlord Demitrian waits alone. He calls himself a loyal servant of Prince Thunderaan and knows how to wake the sleeping elemental lord. Those who bring him ancient elemental bindings seek the Windseeker's power.

sections.title: Hermit of the Crystal Vale
sections.body: In the Crystal Vale, Demitrian lingers at an abandoned encampment in Silithus's desolate wastes. The ruined camp belongs to the Twilight's Hammer, and the solitary human seems out of place there. Yet Demitrian's chief purpose is to herald Prince Thunderaan, the Windseeker. He gives visitors little notice unless they carry proof of the Windseeker's shattered essence.

sections.title: The Vessel of Rebirth
sections.body: Demitrian's purpose is to bring about Thunderaan's resurrection. When someone brings him the Bindings of the Windseeker, relics torn from fire elementals within the Molten Core, he gives them the Vessel of Rebirth. To restore his prince's physical form, he demands rare elemental reagents. They include vast quantities of enchanted elementium and the essence of the Firelord.

sections.title: Betrayal of the Windseeker
sections.body: Demitrian's ritual calls Prince Thunderaan into the Crystal Vale, where the restored Windseeker must be faced in battle. Once the elemental lord is vanquished, the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade is recovered and brought to the terrified Demitrian. In exchange, he awakens Thunderfury.

faq.q: Where can I find Highlord Demitrian?
faq.answer: Find Demitrian at the Ravaged Twilight Camp in the Crystal Vale, at Silithus's far northwestern corner.

faq.q: Why does Demitrian only give a generic response?
faq.answer: Demitrian gives no further response unless you carry at least one half of the Bindings of the Windseeker. Baron Geddon and Garr hold these rare treasures within the Molten Core.

faq.q: What is Demitrian's relationship to Prince Thunderaan?
faq.answer: Demitrian is the sworn mortal servant of Prince Thunderaan. He seeks the prince's severed bindings to restore the elemental lord to the physical plane.

faq.q: What happens when you bring him all the materials for the vessel?
aliases: what does demitrian do with the vessel
faq.answer: Demitrian performs a ritual that calls Prince Thunderaan into the Crystal Vale and restores the Windseeker to the physical plane.

faq.q: Is Demitrian affiliated with the Twilight's Hammer cult?
faq.answer: Demitrian is tied to the Twilight's Hammer and dwells in their ravaged camp. He speaks of the Old Gods with reverence, yet his sworn devotion is to Prince Thunderaan.

faq.q: How do you get Thunderfury from him?
faq.answer: Bring Demitrian both halves of the Bindings of the Windseeker, taken from Baron Geddon and Garr in the Molten Core. Then gather the rare materials he demands for the Vessel of Rebirth. The ritual's outcome and the blade's awakening are told in the hidden passages.

angles.text: Thunderaan's rebirth calls for extensive blacksmithing skill to forge Enchanted Elementium Bars from raw ore and fiery essences.
As a warrior seeking Thunderfury, seek Demitrian to begin the trial of unbinding and awakening the Windseeker.
As a rogue hunting the Windseeker's legendary blade, bargain with Demitrian in Silithus to restore the shattered prince.
